recipes.name: Amok Trey – Cambodian Fish Curry
recipes.notes: Source: TheMealDB id 53495. Free for commercial use. https://www.themealdb.com/

steps.title: Step 1
steps.instruction: 1. In a medium bowl, combine the coconut milk, red curry paste, fish sauce, palm sugar, and broth, whisking until smooth—this ensures no lumps in the sauce.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.instruction: 2. Heat the vegetable oil in a large skillet over medium heat (about 350°F) for 30 seconds until shimmering.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.instruction: 3. Pour the coconut milk mixture into the skillet and bring it to a gentle simmer, stirring occasionally, which should take about 3-4 minutes.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.instruction: 4. Add the fish cubes and kaffir lime leaves to the skillet, submerging them fully in the sauce.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.instruction: 5. Reduce the heat to low, cover the skillet, and let it cook for 10 minutes until the fish is opaque and flakes easily with a fork—avoid overcooking to keep it tender.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.instruction: 6. Stir in the beaten egg slowly, cooking for 2 more minutes until the sauce thickens slightly, which adds a rich, custard-like texture.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.instruction: 7. While the curry simmers, prepare the banana leaves by briefly passing them over a gas flame for 10 seconds to make them pliable, or use parchment paper as a handy alternative.

steps.title: Step 8
steps.instruction: 8. Spoon the curry into the center of each banana leaf square, folding the edges to form a tight packet to trap steam.

steps.title: Step 9
steps.instruction: 9. Place the packets in a steamer basket over boiling water and steam for 10 minutes until heated through and fragrant.

steps.title: Step 10
steps.instruction: 10. Carefully unwrap the packets and garnish with fresh cilantro and lime wedges before serving

recipes.name: Bai Sach Chrouk – Grilled Pork with Rice
recipes.notes: Source: TheMealDB id 53496. Free for commercial use. https://www.themealdb.com/

steps.title: Step 1
steps.instruction: 1. In a large bowl, combine the coconut milk, soy sauce, oyster sauce, honey, minced garlic, and black pepper to make the marinade.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.instruction: 2. Add the thinly sliced pork shoulder to the marinade, ensuring each piece is fully coated, then cover and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes to allow the flavors to penetrate.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.instruction: 3. While the pork marinates, rinse the jasmine rice under cold water until the water runs clear to remove excess starch, which helps prevent clumping.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.instruction: 4. In a medium pot, combine the rinsed rice and 4 cups of water, bring to a boil over high heat, then reduce to a simmer, cover, and cook for 15 minutes until the water is absorbed and the rice is tender.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.instruction: 5. Heat a grill pan or outdoor grill to medium-high heat (about 400°F) and lightly brush with vegetable oil to prevent sticking.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.instruction: 6. Remove the pork from the marinade, shaking off any excess, and place it on the hot grill, cooking for 3-4 minutes per side until nicely charred and cooked through with an internal temperature of 145°F.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.instruction: 7. Tip: Avoid overcrowding the grill pan to ensure even browning and proper caramelization of the marinade.

steps.title: Step 8
steps.instruction: 8. Once the pork is grilled, let it rest for 5 minutes before slicing to retain its juices and tenderness.

steps.title: Step 9
steps.instruction: 9. Tip: If you prefer a saucier dish, simmer the leftover marinade in a small saucepan for 5 minutes until slightly thickened and drizzle it over the pork.

steps.title: Step 10
steps.instruction: 10. Fluff the cooked rice with a fork to separate the grains and serve it warm alongside the grilled pork slices.

steps.title: Step 11
steps.instruction: 11. Arrange the thinly sliced cucumber and fresh cilantro leaves on top as a refreshing garnish.

steps.title: Step 12
steps.instruction: 12. Tip: For an extra kick, serve with a side of pickled vegetables or a squeeze of lime juice to balance the rich, savory flavors.

recipes.name: BEEF LOK LAK (Lok Lak Sach Ko)

steps.instruction: Fry the eggs sunny-side up and set aside. Finely chop the garlic. Wash the lettuce leaves and drain well. Thinly slice the onion and tomatoes.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.instruction: Cut the beef tenderloin into 2–3 cm cubes. Marinate with sea salt, palm sugar, Chinese cooking wine, oyster sauce, soy sauce, and sesame oil. Mix well.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.instruction: Heat a frying pan on high heat with cooking oil. Add chopped garlic and stir until the garlic browns lightly. Add the marinated beef (with all the marinade) and cook for 5–7 minutes, depending on how rare you want the beef.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.instruction: On a serving plate, arrange a bed of lettuce, then layer tomatoes, then onions. Spoon the cooked beef over the vegetables and place fried eggs on top. Serve with the Kampot pepper sauce and fragrant steamed rice.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.instruction: Sear hot and fast, Lok Lak is at its best when the beef stays tender and juicy, with a bold, bright dipping sauce to cut through the richness.

recipes.name: Belgian Stoemp
recipes.notes: Source: TheMealDB id 53468. Free for commercial use. https://www.themealdb.com/

steps.title: Step 1
steps.instruction: 1. Add the chopped potatoes and garlic to a high pan and fill it with tap water until the potatoes are fully submerged.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.instruction: 2. Add some salt. Then place the pan over high heat and bring the potatoes to a boil. Cook them until tender. In the meantime rinse and drain the savoy cabbage. Slice it up finely.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.instruction: 3. Add a tablespoon of butter to a large non-stick pan. Place it over medium-high heat. Once melted, add the savoy cabbage. Season with a pinch of pepper and salt.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.instruction: 4. Stir fry the cabbage for 15 to 20 minutes or until the cabbage is soft and tender. Then turn the heat off and take the cabbage off the heat. In the meantime, pan fry the sausages (or sliced bacon if you are using both) in a non-stick pan in a tablespoon of butter or oil until golden brown and cooked through.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.instruction: 5. Transfer the sausages (and bacon) to a plate and cover with a lid or tinfoil to keep the meat warm. In the same greasy pan, add the sliced onion and extra butter and cook it gently over medium heat for 10 minutes until softened. (I often add diced bacon as well, if I only serve the stoemp with sausages.)

steps.title: Step 6
steps.instruction: 6. Then add the beer and turn the heat up. Let the beer reduce until you get a nice beer and onion sauce (you can add a little flour or sauce thickener if you like). Add the pan fried meat back to the pan and cover to keep warm.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.instruction: 7. Drain the cooked potatoes and garlic, add them back to the pan you cooked them in together with the pan fried cabbage and chopped parsley. Sprinkle with some pepper, salt and nutmeg. Also add the milk and the rest of the unsalted butter.

steps.title: Step 8
steps.instruction: 8. Mash the potatoes, parsley and cabbage up. Add extra butter or milk if necessary. Also check the seasoning and add extra pepper, nutmeg or salt to taste if necessary. Scoop the cabbage mash onto plates and top with the pan fried sausages (and bacon). Drizzle with the beer and onion sauce. Serve hot.

recipes.name: Belgian Waterzooi Chicken
recipes.notes: Source: TheMealDB id 53466. Free for commercial use. https://www.themealdb.com/

steps.title: Step 1
steps.instruction: Put the chicken, water and one garlic clove in a large saucepan. Place it over medium-high heat until boiling. Then turn the heat low, cover the pan and simmer the chicken for 10 minutes. Remove the chicken leg and breast. Keep the fresh chicken stock for later.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.instruction: Let the chicken cool. Then dice the chicken breast up. Pick the meat off the leg. Discard any bones and skin. Slice the leek, celery and carrot finely (julienne). Add the butter, rosemary and bay leaves to a large pan and place it over medium heat until melted.

steps.title: Step 3

steps.title: Step 4
steps.instruction: Stir and cook the vegetables for 3 minutes. Then add the shredded and diced chicken.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.instruction: Cover the pan and cook the chicken and vegetables for 5 minutes. Then add the cream and ½ cup (120 ml) of the fresh chicken stock.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.instruction: Look at this delicious waterzooi recipe! Do try out my chunky chicken stew with fresh leeks, celery, carrots and lots of cream... This is Belgian comfort food!

steps.title: Step 7
steps.instruction: Cover the pan and cook the stew for 20 minutes until the potatoes are tender. Add the egg yolk and 2 tablespoons of the warm cream from the pan to a cup. Whisk and add it back to the pan to thicken the sauce.

steps.title: Step 8
steps.instruction: Stir all the ingredients and then turn the heat very low. Check the seasoning and add extra pepper or salt to taste. Remove the rosemary and bay leaves. Divide the stew over deep plates and drizzle with the remaining cream sauce. Serve hot.

steps.instruction: Fill the biggest saucepan you own with salted water and bring it to a boil over high heat. Now pull the outer leaves off of the cabbage (save them) and drop the rest of it, whole, into the water. steps.title: Step 10
steps.instruction: The reason you are doing this is because it's difficult to get whole cabbage leaves off of an American cabbage. The cabbages you typically buy in our supermarkets come in very tight round balls, and because the leaves are crispy they will snap and crack when you try to pull them off in an un-blanched state. Blanching them for a few minutes makes it so they will come right off without tearing.

Carefully pull the leaves off the cabbage, cutting them at the base if you have to do so to loosen them. Try to get them off in one piece. If the inner leaves are still crispy, return the cabbage to the boiling water for another three or four minutes. Repeat until all of the useable leaves are free.

steps.title: Step 3

steps.title: Step 4
steps.instruction: Add onion slices and cook for 1 minute until slightly softened.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.instruction: Stir the batter briefly and pour about 1/2 cup into the skillet, immediately swirling to coat the bottom thinly.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.instruction: Scatter bean sprouts over half of the pancake and cover the skillet with a lid for 2 minutes to steam the sprouts.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.instruction: Uncover and cook for another 3–4 minutes until the edges curl and turn golden brown and crispy.

steps.title: Step 8
steps.instruction: Fold the pancake in half over the bean sprouts using a spatula, then transfer to a plate.

steps.title: Step 9
steps.instruction: Repeat steps 2–8 with remaining batter and ingredients, adding oil as needed to prevent sticking.

steps.title: Step 10
steps.instruction: Serve immediately with fish sauce for dipping.

recipes.name: Lakra me Mish Cabbage and Meat Stew

steps.title: Step 2
steps.instruction: Cooking

steps.title: Step 3
steps.instruction: Add some olive oil to a saute pan or saucepan (one with a lid). One heated add in the onions, diced beef, red peppers and fry for 5 minutes stirring occasionally. The meat should be fully browned.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.instruction: Add the paprika, tomato puree, chilli flakes and season with salt and pepper. Mix together and continue to fry for 2 minutes.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.instruction: Add the cabbage and stir the mixture together. Fry the mixture while stirring occasionally for 3-5 minutes. Most of the oil should have burned away.

steps.title: Step 9
steps.instruction: Pour the boiling water into the pan, ensuring that the water level completely covers the cabbage, plus about 1 inch above it. Put on the lid and bring to the boil.

steps.title: Step 11
steps.instruction: Leave to simmer for 2.5 hours. The stew is ready when the cabbage is soft and meat tender.

steps.title: Step 13
steps.instruction: Serving

steps.title: Step 14
steps.instruction: Serve into wide bowls and leave to cool for 5 minutes.

recipes.name: Lao Naem Khao
recipes.notes: Source: TheMealDB id 53427. Free for commercial use. https://www.themealdb.com/

steps.title: Step 1
steps.instruction: Slice the onion and shallots thinly. Let them soak in a ice water bath while preparing the rest of the meal.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.instruction: Grate the coconut. Put in a large bowl.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.instruction: Add the coconut in a large bowl. Add the rice. Using your hands, mix the coconut and rice together.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.instruction: Roll the mixture to form 2-inch rice ball croquettes.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.instruction: Heat up the cooking oil in a pot or pan.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.instruction: Beat two eggs and a large bowl. Dip the balls into the egg mixture. Then, drop the balls into the cooking oil.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.instruction: Allow the balls to turn a dark amber brown color. Deep fry until crispy, crunchy, and golden. Remove and set on paper towel to drain excess oil.

steps.title: Step 8
steps.instruction: Once cooled, break apart the rice balls and add into a larger bowl.

steps.title: Step 9
steps.instruction: Drain the onion and the shallots.

steps.title: Step 10
steps.instruction: Make sure you tear the pork sausage up into small pieces. You can use a knife too, but the traditional method is tearing.

steps.title: Step 11
steps.instruction: In the large bowl, add in the onion, shallots, sour pork sausage, pickled garlic, lime juice, fish sauce, sugar, cilantro, hot mint, regular mint.

steps.title: Step 12
steps.instruction: Top with peanuts. Serve with Lettuce, dry chilli, and other fresh vegetables.

steps.title: Step 13
steps.instruction: Preserving Naem Khao Recipe

steps.title: Step 14
steps.instruction: Naem Khao can be kept in the refrigerator for 4 days. It can then be served chilled.

recipes.name: Leg of Lamb Armenian-Style
recipes.notes: Source: TheMealDB id 53437. Free for commercial use. https://www.themealdb.com/

steps.title: Step 1
steps.instruction: Place all of the above ingredients into your roaster pan at least two days before you want to eat.  Stir occasionally throughout the days to distribute marinade evenly. Bake at a 350-degree oven for 1 hour to 1 1/2 hours or until meat is not red when sliced.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.instruction: You can also make these on skewers if you wish to go through the process of spearing the meat with other veggies to grill. Freezes well.

recipes.name: Macaroni Pie
recipes.notes: Source: TheMealDB id 53461. Free for commercial use. https://www.themealdb.com/

steps.title: Step 1
steps.instruction: Bring water to a boil and add the broken-up macaroni, elbows, and salt. Cook uncovered until tender but not overcooked (about 8 minutes).

steps.title: Step 2
steps.instruction: Preheat a moderately hot oven to 350F, 180C, or Gas Mark 4.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.instruction: Drain the macaroni thoroughly, put it back into the same hot saucepan cooked in, and mix in the butter.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.instruction: Grate the cheese and mix it with the macaroni while it is still warm.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.instruction: Whisk the egg until fluffy, and add the milk, onion powder, white pepper, salt, pepper sauce, and mustard. Pour in with the macaroni and mix.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.instruction: Place in a greased ovenproof casserole dish. Top with butter, some grated cheese, and fine breadcrumbs. Bake in the center of the oven for about 30-45 minutes, depending on the dish’s depth.

recipes.name: Macaroni Pudding
recipes.notes: Source: TheMealDB id 53504. Free for commercial use. https://www.themealdb.com/

steps.title: Step 1
steps.instruction: Add macaroni to large pan with sufficient water to cover (approximately 4 cups). Add salt and bring to boil until tender (approximately 25 -30 minutes). Meanwhile, beat eggs and sugar together, then add vanilla and nutmeg. Mix well and set aside. In a separate medium sauce pan, heat evaporated milk plus 1 cup of water and butter to almost a boiling point. Remove from heat and add to sugar mixture. Drain cooked macaroni. Add macaroni and raisins to the milk mixture and stir well. (This mixture will have quite a bit of liquid, but this will form a nice custard textured pudding once baked.)

steps.title: Step 2
steps.instruction: Grease a large baking dish with butter or margarine, add the macaroni mixture and sprinkle with additional nutmeg. Bake at 350° F for 1 hour or until golden brown. (Pudding should be firm enough to cut, but moist and not dry).

recipes.name: Madombi: Dumplings from Botswana
recipes.notes: Source: TheMealDB id 53472. Free for commercial use. https://www.themealdb.com/

steps.title: Step 1
steps.instruction: This recipe requires a stew to steam the dumplings on top of, at abour 180℃ or 350℉, give or take (it doesn't have to be specific, but can't be very high or very love heat). You will add the dumplings in during the last thirty minutes of your stew's cooking time, They need to steam covered, so the stew should be in a lidded pot that is oven-proof.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.instruction: Mix the dumpling dough

steps.title: Step 3
steps.instruction: In a measuring cup, combine the warm water, sugar, and yeast. Leave until foamy, about 5 minutes.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.instruction: To a stand mixer bowl, or a large bowl if mixing by hand, add the flour and salt. Stream in the water-yeast mixture while kneading.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.instruction: Knead for several minutes after the dough comes together, until a smooth ball of dough forms.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.instruction: Leave the dumpling dough to rise

steps.title: Step 7
steps.instruction: Place the ball of dough in an oiled dough, cover, and leave to rise until doubled, about 1 hour.

steps.title: Step 8
steps.instruction: Shape the dumplings

steps.title: Step 9
steps.instruction: Divide the risen ball of dough into 10 equal portions for large dumplings, or 12-14 portions for smaller dumplings.

steps.title: Step 10
steps.instruction: Shape each portion of dough into a smooth, round ball.

steps.title: Step 11
steps.instruction: Steam the dumplings

steps.title: Step 12
steps.instruction: In the last thirty minutes of cooking a stew, place the shaped dumplings right atop the stew. Push them down gently into the stew. Cover tightly and return to the oven for 25-30 minutes. The dumplings are done when they're risen and light golden.

recipes.name: Mastawa Lamb and Rice
recipes.notes: Source: TheMealDB id 53400. Free for commercial use. https://www.themealdb.com/

steps.title: Step 1
steps.instruction: 1. Place the meat cut into pieces, in a large pan with the onions. Add the turmeric and enough water to cover. Bring to the boil then cook gently until the meat is very tender and can easily be removed from the bones.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.instruction: 2. While the meat is cooking, cut the orange peel into thin match style pieces, removing as much pith as possible. Leave to soak in a bowl of water.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.instruction: 3. When the meat is tender, remove from the pan and when cool enough, remove the meat from the bones and shred the meat into strips with your hands. Return the meat to the pan.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.instruction: 4. Wash the short grain rice and then add to the pan with salt according to taste. The juices should cover the rice by about 2cm, add more water if necessary. Bring back to the boil, then reduce the heat to medium and cook with the lid off, stirring from time to time until the rice is "al dente" and the liquid is absorbed.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.instruction: 5. Add the natural yoghurt, and stir in well but carefully. Fry the crushed cloves of garlic in the oil and add to the dish along with the dill, black pepper, the chickpeas and extra salt to taste.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.instruction: 6. Mix in well, then cover the top of the pan with a clean thick cloth and the lid. Leave on a low heat for about half an hour to allow the flavours to absorb.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.instruction: Enjoy with some warm nan bread for extra comfort.

recipes.name: Meang Nem
recipes.notes: Source: TheMealDB id 53423. Free for commercial use. https://www.themealdb.com/

steps.title: Step 1
steps.instruction: Rinse the rice, soak in water for about 10 minutes, then drain well. Heat a wok or large skillet over medium heat. Add the rice and stir constantly until evenly dark golden brown and very fragrant, about 5 minutes. Transfer to a bowl to cool. Grind finely using a spice grinder or mortar and pestle, then sift through a fine mesh strainer to remove any large pieces. Set aside.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.instruction: Thinly slice the shallots lengthwise. Finely chop the galangal, pickled scallion heads, chili peppers, and bitter orange zest. Coarsely grind the roasted peanuts. Heat a frying pan over low heat, add shredded coconut, and toast, stirring, for 2–3 minutes. Set aside.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.instruction: In a large bowl, combine lime juice, bitter orange juice, palm sugar, pickled scallion brine, and fish sauce. Stir until fully dissolved and well mixed.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.instruction: In a mixing bowl, combine dried shrimp, toasted coconut, chopped aromatics, and dressing. Mix well. Add roasted rice powder and stir again. Top with coarsely ground roasted peanuts.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.instruction: Place the salad on a large plate. Let each guest spoon a little onto their own small plate, wrap in leafy greens with vegetables, and enjoy in bite-size portions.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.instruction: For a vegetarian version, omit the dried shrimp and fish sauce. Season to taste with soy sauce and a pinch of sea salt, keeping the sweet-sour balance.

recipes.name: Muraba-E-Kadu (Pumpkin Jam)
recipes.notes: Source: TheMealDB id 53403. Free for commercial use. https://www.themealdb.com/

steps.title: Step 1
steps.instruction: 1. Remove the skin of the pumpkin. Also remove the inner seeds.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.instruction: 2. Cut the flesh into 2cm cubes.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.instruction: 3. Take the zest off the oranges, with as little pith as possible, and cut into matchstick-sized strips.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.instruction: 4. Extract the juice from the oranges. Remove the seeds from the cardamom pods and reserve.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.instruction: 5. Place the pumpkin, orange juice, orange strips, sugar and whole cardamom pod seeds in a large pan, mix well and leave to marinate for about 10 hours or overnight. Stir occasionally.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.instruction: 6. Bring the mixture to the boil, then reduce the heat and simmer until the liquid has thickened and become syrupy. This can take about an hour or a little bit longer.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.instruction: Leave to cool then place in clean, dry jars. Enjoy!

recipes.name: Nom Banh Chok – Cambodian Noodle Soup
recipes.notes: Source: TheMealDB id 53497. Free for commercial use. https://www.themealdb.com/

steps.title: Step 1
steps.instruction: 1. Heat the vegetable oil in a large pot over medium heat until it shimmers, about 2 minutes.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.instruction: 2. Add the minced garlic and sauté until fragrant and lightly golden, about 1 minute, stirring constantly to prevent burning.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.instruction: 3. Add the chicken pieces and cook until they turn opaque on all sides, about 5 minutes, stirring occasionally.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.instruction: 4. Pour in the 8 cups of water and bring to a boil over high heat, which should take about 8 minutes.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.instruction: 5. Reduce the heat to low, stir in the fish sauce, salt, and sugar, and simmer uncovered for 20 minutes to develop the flavors.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.instruction: 6. While the broth simmers, cook the rice noodles according to package instructions until al dente, then drain and rinse under cold water to stop the cooking.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.instruction: 7. Divide the cooked noodles evenly among four bowls.

steps.title: Step 8
steps.instruction: 8. Ladle the hot broth and chicken over the noodles in each bowl.

steps.title: Step 9
steps.instruction: 9. Top each bowl with bean sprouts, chopped mint leaves, and optional red chili slices.

steps.title: Step 10
steps.instruction: 10. Serve immediately with lime wedges on the side for squeezing over the soup.

recipes.name: Num Pang – Cambodian Baguette Sandwich
recipes.notes: Source: TheMealDB id 53501. Free for commercial use. https://www.themealdb.com/

steps.title: Step 1
steps.instruction: 1. In a medium bowl, whisk together the soy sauce and honey to create a marinade.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.instruction: 2. Add the chicken thigh strips to the marinade, ensuring each piece is fully coated, and let it sit for 20 minutes at room temperature.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.instruction: 3. While the chicken marinates, combine the julienned carrots, daikon radish, rice vinegar, and granulated sugar in a separate bowl, stirring until the sugar dissolves to pickle the vegetables.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.instruction: 4. In a small bowl, mix the mayonnaise and sriracha sauce thoroughly to make a spicy aioli.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.instruction: 5. Heat the vegetable oil in a large skillet or wok over medium-high heat until it shimmers, about 2 minutes.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.instruction: 6. Add the marinated chicken strips to the hot skillet in a single layer, cooking for 4-5 minutes per side until they reach an internal temperature of 165°F and develop a golden-brown crust.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.instruction: 7. While the chicken cooks, lightly toast the split baguettes in a toaster oven or under a broiler for 2-3 minutes until just crisp on the edges.

steps.title: Step 8
steps.instruction: 8. Spread a generous layer of the spicy aioli on the inside of each toasted baguette.

steps.title: Step 9
steps.instruction: 9. Drain the pickled carrots and daikon radish from their liquid, then layer them onto the bottom half of each baguette.

steps.title: Step 10
steps.instruction: 10. Place the cooked chicken strips evenly over the pickled vegetables in each sandwich.

steps.title: Step 11
steps.instruction: 11. Top the chicken with fresh cilantro leaves and thinly sliced cucumber.

steps.title: Step 12
steps.instruction: 12. Close the sandwiches by pressing the top half of each baguette down gently.

recipes.name: Open-faced Sandwich With Potato
recipes.notes: Source: TheMealDB id 53554. Free for commercial use. https://www.themealdb.com/

steps.title: Step 1
steps.instruction: Scrub the potatoes clean and place in a small saucepan with water and 1 tablespoon of salt. Bring to a boil and simmer the potatoes for about 10 minutes. Turn off the heat and let the potatoes stand in the water for 5 minutes. Drain the potatoes and allow to cool slightly. Remember that potatoes come in various sizes, so the cooking time may vary – if they do not easily glide off of a fork when speared and lifted out of the water, they are not done yet.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.instruction: Fry bacon slices and transfer to a dish lined with paper towels.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.instruction: Peel the red onion and slice in thin rings.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.instruction: Transfer the flour to a bowl and toss the onions in the flour. Remove onions and shake off excess flour.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.instruction: Heat the oil in a saucepan over medium heat. You can test whether the oil is hot enough by adding a small piece of onion to the saucepan. If the oil bubbles around the onion, the oil is ready.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.instruction: Transfer as many onion rings to the saucepan as can fit in one layer. Do not add too many onion rings at once.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.instruction: Fry the onions for a couple of minutes until they are golden brown. Transfer onions to a dish lined with paper towels and sprinkle with salt. Repeat the process until all onions are fried.

steps.title: Step 8
steps.instruction: Butter a slice of dark rye bread and arrange round potato slices (or, if the potatoes are very small, halved potatoes) on top. Top your open potato sandwich with a good mayonnaise, crispy fried onions, fried bacon and sliced chives.

recipes.name: Papas Chorreadas Recipe (Potatoes with Cream and Cheese Sauce)
recipes.notes: Source: TheMealDB id 53534. Free for commercial use. https://www.themealdb.com/

steps.title: Step 1
steps.instruction: Place the potatoes and chicken bouillon in a medium saucepan. Cover with water and bring to a boil and cook about 30 minutes until tender. Drain and set a side.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.instruction: While the potatoes are cooking, heat the oil and butter in a frying pan over medium heat. Add onion and tomatoes, stir and cook about 7 minutes. Add garlic powder, cumin, salt and pepper. Stir and cook 2 minutes more.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.instruction: Add cream, cilantro and cheese. Mix well and turn down the heat and cook for 3 minutes or until cheese has melted.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.instruction: In a serving dish place the potatoes and pour the sauce on top. Serve them hot.

recipes.name: Pastel de Choclo
recipes.notes: Source: TheMealDB id 53520. Free for commercial use. https://www.themealdb.com/

steps.title: Step 1
steps.instruction: Place eggs in a saucepan and cover with water. Bring to a boil, remove from heat, and let eggs stand in hot water for 15 minutes.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.instruction: Meanwhile, heat oil in a skillet over medium heat. Add onions, garlic, 1 pinch salt, ¼ teaspoon paprika, and black pepper; cook until fragrant, about 2 minutes. Add beef, remaining 1 teaspoon salt, remaining ¼ teaspoon paprika, and black pepper; cook and stir until beef mostly browned, about 5 minutes. Add chicken, raisins, and olives.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.instruction: Remove eggs from hot water, cool under cold running water, and peel. Roughly chop; add to beef mixture. Keep pino warm.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.instruction: Combine corn and basil in a blender or the bowl of a food processor; blend until smooth. Pour into a saucepan over medium heat. Add butter; cook and stir until thickened, 7 to 10 minutes. Stir in milk, 2 teaspoons sugar, and salt; cook until thickened to a paste, about 15 minutes more.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.instruction: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C).

steps.title: Step 6
steps.instruction: Spread pino into a baking dish. Cover with corn paste; sprinkle a little sugar on top.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.instruction: Bake in the preheated oven until golden brown on top, about 20 minutes.

recipes.name: Pastel de Papas (Chilean Potato Pie)
recipes.notes: Source: TheMealDB id 53517. Free for commercial use. https://www.themealdb.com/

steps.title: Step 1
steps.instruction: Place potatoes into a large pot and cover with salted water; bring to a boil. Reduce the heat to medium-low and simmer until tender, about 20 minutes.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.instruction: While the potatoes are cooking, heat oil in a large skillet over medium heat. Add onion; cook and stir until translucent, about 5 minutes, adding garlic for the last minute. Stir in diced tomatoes and tomato paste; cook until tomatoes soften and begin to lose their shape, 3 to 5 minutes.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.instruction: Add ground beef to the skillet; cook and stir until browned and crumbly, about 10 minutes. Stir in Panquehue cheese, parsley, and cayenne pepper; season with salt and pepper. Turn off the heat and let sit until needed.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.instruction: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C). Grease a 2-quart baking dish.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.instruction: Drain potatoes in a colander, then allow to steam dry for 1 to 2 minutes. Transfer potatoes back to the pot, add butter and salt, and mash until smooth. Let cool until just warm, 5 to 10 minutes, then stir in beaten egg.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.instruction: Spread 1/2 of the mashed potatoes over the bottom of the prepared baking dish. Layer ground beef mixture over top, then completely cover with remaining potatoes.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.instruction: Bake in the preheated oven until potatoes are hot and lightly browned on top, about 40 minutes.

recipes.name: Picadillo de Vainicas (Green Beans Picadillo)
recipes.notes: Source: TheMealDB id 53539. Free for commercial use. https://www.themealdb.com/

steps.title: Step 1
steps.instruction: In a medium-size pot over medium heat add some olive oil, onions, pepper, and garlic and cook until onion is translucent.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.instruction: In the meantime, finely chopped the green beans.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.instruction: Add to the pot, the shredded meat, green beans, thyme, salt and pepper, and mix well. Add the water, cover and cook for 15 minutes, uncover and cook for 5 more minutes or until the green beans are soft.

recipes.name: Pollo en Salsa
recipes.notes: Source: TheMealDB id 53540. Free for commercial use. https://www.themealdb.com/

steps.title: Step 1
steps.instruction: Chopped pepper, onion and tomato and set aside. Turn on Instant Pot in sauteed setting for 8 minutes. Add a little bit of olive oil and add, onion, garlic, tomato, bell pepper, cumin, oregano salt and pepper and sauteed for 4 minutes.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.instruction: Add the chicken and cook for 2 minutes on each side often, mixing often. Add the chicken stock , cover and set the pressure cooker on high for 20 minutes. When done release the pressure and if need it, add a little bit more salt. I like to serve it with some of the juice over rice and beans.

recipes.name: Porotos Granados (Chilean Bean Stew)
recipes.notes: Source: TheMealDB id 53521. Free for commercial use. https://www.themealdb.com/

steps.title: Step 1
steps.instruction: Heat the olive oil in a stock pot over medium heat; add the onion and cover. Cook the onions until soft and translucent, about 5 minutes. Stir the squash, great Northern beans, and lima beans into the pot; pour the chicken stock over the mixture. Cover and cook until the squash is tender and beginning to break apart, 30 to 45 minutes.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.instruction: Stir the corn and basil into the stew; cook until the stew reaches the consistency of pancake batter, about 10 minutes more. Sprinkle the chopped banana pepper over individual portions to serve.

recipes.name: Potato Moussaka Recipe
recipes.notes: Source: TheMealDB id 53489. Free for commercial use. https://www.themealdb.com/

steps.title: Step 1
steps.instruction: Preheat oven to 350 F.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.instruction: Heat oil in a skillet. Add the ground meat and cook, breaking it down with a wooden spoon for 6-7 minutes, until browned. Add onion and garlic. Add carrots (optional).Add salt, black pepper, dried mint, summer savory, thyme (optional), tomato sauce and tomato paste. Cook for 2-3 minutes, stirring frequently.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.instruction: Grease a 9×9 or 9×13 baking dish with oil.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.instruction: Add in the drained potatoes and meat mixture. Stir to evenly distribute the meat into the potatoes.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.instruction: Add cold water to the baking dish, so it just covers the top of the potatoes.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.instruction: Bake for 40-50 minutes, until the water is absorbed by the potatoes and they are fully cooked.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.instruction: In the mean time prepare the Bechamel sauce (or the Bulgarian Style Topping).

steps.title: Step 8
steps.instruction: For the Bechamel:

steps.title: Step 9
steps.instruction: In a bowl, swish egg yolks. Set aside.

steps.title: Step 10
steps.instruction: Melt butter in a saucepan. add flour. Cook for 3 minutes on medium heat, stirring frequently.

steps.title: Step 11
steps.instruction: Slowly add the milk, whisking to incorporate. Add salt and nutmeg. Cook for 3 minutes, until thickened. Let the mixture cool for 5 minutes. Add in the egg yolks (with feta). Let the sauce stand at room temperature, while the potatoes and meat are cooking.

steps.title: Step 12
steps.instruction: Pour the sauce over the cooked potatoes. Top with cheese. Bake for 15 minutes, until golden. You can broil for 1-2 minutes, if the top is not getting to the desired golden color.

steps.title: Step 13
steps.instruction: For the Bulgarian Moussaka topping:

steps.title: Step 14
steps.instruction: In a bowl beat together eggs, yogurt, milk, flour, then add salt and baking soda.

recipes.name: Prahok Ktis – Pork and Coconut Dip
recipes.notes: Source: TheMealDB id 53499. Free for commercial use. https://www.themealdb.com/

steps.title: Step 1
steps.instruction: 1. Heat 2 tbsp vegetable oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat until shimmering, about 1 minute.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.instruction: 2. Add 4 cloves minced garlic and 2 finely chopped shallots to the skillet, stirring constantly until fragrant and lightly golden, 2-3 minutes.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.instruction: 3. Tip: Keep the heat medium to prevent burning—garlic can turn bitter if overcooked.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.instruction: 4. Add 1 lb ground pork to the skillet, breaking it up with a spoon, and cook until no pink remains, 5-7 minutes.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.instruction: 5. Stir in 3 tbsp prahok and cook for 1 minute to blend the flavors, mashing it slightly into the pork.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.instruction: 6. Pour in 1 cup coconut milk, stirring to combine, then reduce heat to medium-low and simmer for 10 minutes until the mixture thickens slightly.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.instruction: 7. Tip: Simmer gently to avoid curdling the coconut milk—a steady bubble is ideal.

steps.title: Step 8
steps.instruction: 8. Add 2 tbsp fish sauce, 1 tbsp palm sugar, and 2 minced Thai chilies, stirring until the sugar dissolves, about 2 minutes.

steps.title: Step 9
steps.instruction: 9. Remove the skillet from heat and stir in 2 tbsp lime juice, mixing thoroughly.

steps.title: Step 10
steps.instruction: 10. Tip: Add lime juice off the heat to preserve its fresh, tangy flavor without cooking it out.

steps.title: Step 11
steps.instruction: 11. Transfer the dip to a serving bowl and garnish with ¼ cup chopped fresh cilantro.

steps.title: Step 12
steps.instruction: 12. Let the dip cool for 5 minutes before serving to allow the flavors to meld.

recipes.name: Presh me Oriz Leek and Rice Bake
recipes.notes: Source: TheMealDB id 53410. Free for commercial use. https://www.themealdb.com/

steps.instruction: Cooking

steps.instruction: Fry the leeks in a small dash of olive oil for a few minutes until they start to brown.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.instruction: Add the onions and mince and fry until everything is browned. Ensure you keep stirring to prevent the leeks catching and burning.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.instruction: Add the rice and stir together for a few minutes ensuring the rice is well blended and coated in any juices.

steps.title: Step 9
steps.instruction: Add the lamb stock, salt and pepper. Give it a good stir and leave it to come to the boil. Leave to boil for 2 minutes.

steps.title: Step 11
steps.instruction: Baking

steps.title: Step 12
steps.instruction: Pour the mixture into a large baking tray, place on the bottom self of a preheated oven at 180 degrees. Leave to bake for up to 1 hour. The dish is ready when all the liquid is evaporated and the rice is soft.

recipes.name: Ropa Veija
recipes.notes: Source: TheMealDB id 53545. Free for commercial use. https://www.themealdb.com/

steps.title: Step 1

recipes.name: Samlar Kari – Khmer Red Curry
recipes.notes: Source: TheMealDB id 53498. Free for commercial use. https://www.themealdb.com/

steps.title: Step 1
steps.instruction: 1. Heat 1 tbsp vegetable oil in a large pot or Dutch oven over medium-high heat until it shimmers, about 2 minutes.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.instruction: 2. Add 1 lb chicken pieces to the pot and cook until browned on all sides, approximately 5–7 minutes, stirring occasionally to prevent sticking.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.instruction: 3. Remove the chicken from the pot and set it aside on a plate, leaving any oil and juices in the pot.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.instruction: 4. Reduce the heat to medium and add 1 sliced onion to the pot, cooking until softened and translucent, about 4 minutes.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.instruction: 5. Stir in 3 cloves minced garlic and 1 tbsp grated ginger, cooking for 1 minute until fragrant to avoid burning.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.instruction: 6. Add 2 tbsp red curry paste to the pot and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly to toast the spices and deepen the flavor.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.instruction: 7. Pour in 1 can coconut milk and 1 cup chicken broth, scraping the bottom of the pot to incorporate any browned bits for extra richness.

steps.title: Step 8
steps.instruction: 8. Stir in 1 tbsp fish sauce and 1 tbsp palm sugar until fully dissolved, then return the browned chicken to the pot.

steps.title: Step 9
steps.instruction: 9. Bring the mixture to a gentle boil, then reduce the heat to low, cover, and simmer for 15 minutes to allow the flavors to meld.

steps.title: Step 10
steps.instruction: 10. Add 1 cup bamboo shoots and 1 sliced red bell pepper to the pot, simmering uncovered for an additional 5 minutes until the vegetables are tender-crisp.

steps.title: Step 11
steps.instruction: 11. Remove the pot from the heat and stir in 1 cup Thai basil leaves until just wilted, about 1 minute, to preserve their fresh aroma.

steps.title: Step 12
steps.instruction: 12. Serve the curry hot, garnished with lime wedges for a bright, acidic finish.

recipes.name: Samlar Machu Kreung – Cambodian Sour Stew
recipes.notes: Source: TheMealDB id 53503. Free for commercial use. https://www.themealdb.com/

steps.title: Step 1
steps.instruction: 1. Heat 1 tbsp vegetable oil in a large pot over medium-high heat until it shimmers, about 1 minute.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.instruction: 2. Add 1 lb boneless, skinless chicken thighs to the pot and cook until browned on all sides, approximately 5-7 minutes, stirring occasionally to prevent sticking.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.instruction: 3. Pour 4 cups water into the pot and bring to a boil, then reduce heat to a simmer.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.instruction: 4. Stir in 2 tbsp tamarind paste, 1 tbsp fish sauce, and 1 tsp sugar until fully dissolved, about 1 minute.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.instruction: 5. Add 1 stalk lemongrass and 2 kaffir lime leaves to the pot, then cover and simmer for 10 minutes to infuse the broth with flavor.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.instruction: 6. Tip: Bruising the lemongrass before adding helps release its essential oils for a more aromatic stew.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.instruction: 7. Add 1 cup pineapple chunks, 1 cup cherry tomatoes, and 1 cup green beans to the pot, stirring gently to combine.

steps.title: Step 8
steps.instruction: 8. Simmer uncovered for 10-12 minutes, or until the green beans are tender but still crisp and the tomatoes start to soften.

steps.title: Step 9
steps.instruction: 9. Tip: Avoid overcooking the vegetables to maintain their vibrant color and texture in the final dish.

steps.title: Step 10
steps.instruction: 10. Stir in 1 Thai chili and simmer for an additional 2 minutes to incorporate the heat.

steps.title: Step 11
steps.instruction: 11. Tip: Taste the broth and adjust with extra tamarind paste or fish sauce if desired, but do so gradually to avoid overpowering the balance.

steps.title: Step 12
steps.instruction: 12. Remove the pot from heat and discard the lemongrass and kaffir lime leaves before serving.

steps.title: Step 13
steps.instruction: 13. Present the stew hot in bowls, optionally garnished with fresh herbs like cilantro.
